firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently put their hands in snow takes the First Player card and plays first in the First Generation.
clarifications: At the end of each Generation, pass the First Player card to the player on the left.

sources.title: Ice and the Sky English rulebook
sources.location: The game, opening paragraph; turn order; end-of-Generation procedure
